hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook for the Euler lending protocol. In beforeSwap, it fully controls swap execution: it computes quotes against an internal pricing curve, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, and withdraws output tokens from an Euler vault, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to settle accounting with the PoolManager. Standard liquidity provision is blocked; the hook acts as a single-position AMM backed by Euler vault collateral.
